content: Before using the medication, allow it to thaw at room temperature or in the refrigerator. Do not attempt to thaw it using a water bath or microwave. Once thawed, inspect the container by squeezing it to check for leaks. If the container leaks, discard the solution immediately. Notify your doctor if your condition persists or worsens over time. Be aware that the risk of side effects increases with prolonged use. Common side effects may include headache or diarrhea. Additionally, redness, pain, or swelling at the injection site may occur. It is important to remember that this medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the potential risks of side effects. Rarely, this medication may cause a severe intestinal condition due to a bacterial infection caused by Clostridioides difficile (C. difficile). This condition can occur during treatment or even weeks to months after treatment has been discontinued. Severe allergic reactions to this drug are rare but possible. This is not an exhaustive list of potential side effects. In the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice regarding side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for similar guidance. Before using pantoprazole, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, to similar drugs (such as lansoprazole or omeprazole), or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other complications. Some symptoms may actually indicate a more serious underlying condition. Proton pump inhibitors (PPIs), such as pantoprazole, may increase the risk of bone fractures, particularly with prolonged use, higher doses, and in older adults. Older adults may also be more sensitive to side effects, including bone loss and fractures, as well as C. difficile-associated diarrhea. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. Pantoprazole passes into breast milk, so consult your doctor before breastfeeding. Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs, as well as herbal supplements, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Some products require stomach acid for proper absorption, and pantoprazole reduces stomach acid, which may affect how well these products work. This medication may also interfere with certain laboratory tests, such as urine tests for tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) or blood tests for specific tumors, potentially leading to false results. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call emergency services (911 in the U.S.) immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Laboratory and/or medical tests, such as magnesium blood levels, may be conducted while you are using this medication. Ensure that you attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Different brands of this medication may have different storage requirements. Refer to the product packaging for specific storage instructions or consult your pharmacist. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. For further guidance, consult your pharmacist or local waste disposal company. This information is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
